name: Moss In Shadow
description: Three soft leaf-shapes drift through a deep forest field, opening slightly across the day and settling into a quiet dusk glow by night.
listening: It listens to breath as a slow widening and to the day as a tide, while iDay lays down faint mossy sediment from hour to hour.

curator.verdict: This piece embodies the 'Forest dusk' direction well with its deep green palette and soft, drifting leaf forms that carry a quiet luminosity throughout the day. It remains restrained and elegant, with a calm mood suitable for the setting while subtly evolving.
